items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: I used to go and sing few numbers with Marcelino Guerra

ctx.x: So, in that particular style, Marcelino was as good as Lecuona. That's why Mario recommend Marcelino Guerra to Jack Robbins: "Why don't you bring Marcelino Guerra, he is a great composer"? As a matter of fact, Marcelino Guerra was the top composer in Cuba.
